controls.source_trace: Security action -> structured event -> correlation/outcome -> collection.
controls.controlled_verification: Generate one labeled harmless test event and follow the same ID.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Black-box silence does not prove missing internal logging.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Required actions have usable complete events at the observed collector.

controls.source_trace: Untrusted field -> serialization -> parser -> storage -> rendered viewer.
controls.controlled_verification: Use inert newline/control-character fixtures and inspect record boundaries.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Multiline raw text and forged parsed/viewed records are different effects.
controls.remediation_acceptance: One untrusted field cannot create misleading trusted records in the actual reader.

controls.controlled_verification: Use a unique synthetic secret marker on a controlled failure path.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Do not print or search unrelated real secrets.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Marker is absent from prohibited locations; useful redacted correlation remains.

controls.controlled_verification: Use a test notification destination and record delivery delay.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A source rule or logged event is not proof of notification delivery.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Required signal reaches the intended test recipient inside the configured window.

controls.source_trace: Producer -> queue/buffer -> retry/drop -> health signal -> recovery.
controls.controlled_verification: Use a local failing sink with bounded records.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Do not fill live disks or flood collectors.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Loss/backpressure matches policy and application guarantees survive the failure.

controls.source_trace: Log classification -> readers/writers -> retention/export -> incident use.
controls.controlled_verification: Review effective storage/access policy with supplied operator evidence.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: External testers cannot infer protected internal retention settings.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Intended investigation evidence remains available and unauthorized readers/writers lack access.
